sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: Task WP-031 covers stripper-box changeout with the balance assembly raised after backup-roll removal. The package calls for electrical supply isolation and hydraulic valve closure. The task text contains no instruction to install a positive yoke block or verify the off-center carrier retention envelope.

sections.heading: Circuit nomenclature
sections.text: The cover calls the supply group B hydraulics. A worksheet calls support-chamber trapped energy A. These names are not circuit identities. Use the tag schedule: C17 support chamber and V17 return-isolation valve belong to the raised balance assembly. Do not substitute unrelated A/B circuit records based on the letter alone.

sections.heading: Interpretation limit
sections.text: A procedural omission is distinct from proof of what workers did. Execution records are needed to establish whether a block was actually present. This document does not establish why the procedure omitted that step.
